description: The Encryption Services Module is incorporated into the operating software of the Accompli 009 -- the first wireless communications device to incorporate tri-band GSM and GPRS protocols, phone functionality, Internet access, e-mail, Triple-DES encryption, WAP browser and short message service (SMS) with a full QWERTY keyboard and 256-color screen.
